headline: Chambal Fertilisers And Chemicals (NSEI:CHAMBLFERT) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower On Margin Concerns
summary: The fair value estimate for Chambal Fertilisers and Chemicals has been revised from ₹615.0 to ₹574.5. This resets the reference point many investors use when thinking about upside and downside. This shift reflects changing analyst views on how growth, profitability and execution risk fit together, and what that implies for the stock’s valuation anchor.
